title: Integrate the 20 converted records into the exercise library
acceptance_criteria: The canonical app library exposes all 20 converted source exercises exactly once and retains every existing starter exercise.
The integration uses the parser/conversion contract or a deterministic generated data artifact, with no report-level guidance imported as an Exercise.
Existing starter exercise ids and default local-storage compatibility are not overwritten or made invalid.
The integrated records remain usable by current library filters, routine generation, favorites, and exercise detail rendering.
The web project builds after the library integration.
validation_commands: npm --prefix web run test -- --run src/exerciseCatalogueParser.test.ts src/exerciseCatalogueConversion.test.ts
completion_summary: Integrated 20 deterministic catalogue records, unique combined library IDs, and canonical defaults while preserving starter and stored exercise compatibility.
